evaluation_scope: AWHS/Bull target reproduction plus held-out Flo cycle checks; complete Stricker mapping is audited as construction fidelity, Anckaert provides independent serum subphase checks, Roos motivates timing-heterogeneity guards, and Van Voorhis constrains long-cycle/anovulation dependence in perimenopause.

additional_validation_requirements.requirement: Complete in-cycle Stricker E2 mapping and follicular-area fidelity
additional_validation_requirements.reason: Stricker reports daily LH-aligned medians; the prior filter omitted the early/mid-follicular observations and concealed an early, inflated ramp.

additional_validation_requirements.requirement: Nonzero E2/P4 peak-timing and relative-shape dispersion
additional_validation_requirements.reason: Roos observed heterogeneous serum hormone signal characteristics relative to ultrasound-confirmed ovulation; exact simulator SD bounds are not direct published estimates.

additional_validation_requirements.requirement: Two-sided terminal P4 ratio and final within-cycle drop check
additional_validation_requirements.reason: The Stricker LH+14 median remains above the early-follicular baseline; checking only the cross-cycle jump can miss a reset shifted one day earlier.

additional_validation_requirements.requirement: Perimenopausal long intervals enriched for anovulation
additional_validation_requirements.evidence_role: published conditional-rate context plus investigator-bounded directional joint-dependence check
additional_validation_requirements.reason: Van Voorhis reported 64.7% anovulation among intervals of at least 36 days versus 8.1% among 21-35-day intervals; both the long-cycle posterior and a positive long-versus-ordinary contrast are shown. O'Connor confirms that long ovulatory cycles remain possible minorities.

waveform_diagnostics.scope: Complete ovulatory cycles in the 160 age-balanced retained baseline diaries; values support distribution and dependence QA, not population estimates.
